how_it_works.section_desc: Traditional bingo asks you to trust luck. CryptoBingo lets you trust the code.
how_it_works.step1_desc: In regular bingo, draws happen in closed systems. You can't verify if they were fair.
how_it_works.step2_desc: Every ball drawn is generated by an RSA-SHA256 oracle and recorded on the WAX blockchain. Anyone can verify.
how_it_works.step3_desc: Connect your WAX wallet, buy tickets, and watch every result revealed in real-time on-chain.
